title: Agatu LGA School and Primary Healthcare Directory Starter Data
purpose: Initial structured records for implementing searchable school and healthcare directories in the Agatu LGA website.
important_limitations: This is a starter package based only on records visible in the reviewed conversation, not a complete export of SEMS or the health-facility database.
SEMS statistics previously reviewed reported 62 schools classified as Primary and 5 classified as Pre-primary & Primary for Agatu; the full individual school records have not yet been extracted here.
The school file contains four illustrative records found in the reviewed directory results, not the complete school register.
The healthcare file includes the 51 names summarized in the prior review; community names, facility codes, and operational status are not confirmed in this package.
All records remain needs_confirmation until reconciled with the responsible authority.
Do not describe mission-owned schools as government-supported without supporting evidence.
Do not infer community from a facility name where the official location is not established.

school_source.name: Benue State Smart Education Management System

health_sources.name: Benue State Health Insurance Agency BHCPF facilities directory
